---
title: "Tutorials"
---

C3G tutorials provide accessible, hands-on guidance for navigating computational tools, methods and workflows in genomics and bioinformatics.

## Tutorials Catalog

This page indexes tutorial directories from the [c3g/c3gW-Tutorials](https://github.com/c3g/c3gW-Tutorials) repository.

<div class="workshop-index-controls">
<label for="tutorialFilter">Filter tutorials</label>
<input id="tutorialFilter" type="search" placeholder="Type to filter by name or description" />
</div>

<div id="tutorialTopicFilters" class="workshop-topic-filters" aria-label="Filter by tutorial topic"></div>

<div id="tutorialStatus" class="workshop-index-status" aria-live="polite">Loading tutorials...</div>
<div id="tutorialList" class="workshop-index-list"></div>

<script>
	(async function () {
		const tutorialTopicTag = "tutorial";
		const statusEl = document.getElementById("tutorialStatus");
		const listEl = document.getElementById("tutorialList");
		const filterEl = document.getElementById("tutorialFilter");
		const topicFiltersEl = document.getElementById("tutorialTopicFilters");

		if (!statusEl || !listEl || !filterEl || !topicFiltersEl) {
			console.error("Tutorial index container elements are missing from the page.");
			return;
		}

		async function fetchCatalogData() {
			const response = await fetch("./data/workshops-data.json", { cache: "no-store" });

			if (!response.ok) {
				throw new Error(`Catalog data request failed with status ${response.status}`);
			}

			return response.json();
		}

		function getNonTutorialTopics(item) {
			const topics = Array.isArray(item.topics) ? item.topics : [];
			return topics.filter((topic) => topic !== tutorialTopicTag);
		}

		function formatDate(isoDate) {
			if (!isoDate) {
				return "Unknown update date";
			}

			const parsed = new Date(isoDate);
			return parsed.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
				year: "numeric",
				month: "short",
				day: "numeric"
			});
		}

		function renderCards(items) {
			if (items.length === 0) {
				listEl.innerHTML = "";
				statusEl.textContent = "No tutorials match this filter.";
				return;
			}

			const cards = items.map((item) => {
				const description = item.description
					? item.description
					: "No description provided.";
				const tags = Array.isArray(item.topics) ? item.topics : [];
				const tagsMarkup = tags.length > 0
					? `<div class="workshop-tags">${tags.map((tag) => `<span class="workshop-tag">${tag}</span>`).join("")}</div>`
					: "<div class=\"workshop-tags\"><span class=\"workshop-tag workshop-tag-empty\">untagged</span></div>";

				return `
					<article class="workshop-card">
						<h3><a href="${item.html_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${item.name}</a></h3>
						<p>${description}</p>
						${tagsMarkup}
						<div class="workshop-meta">
							<span>Updated ${formatDate(item.pushed_at)}</span>
							<a href="${item.html_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub</a>
						</div>
					</article>
				`;
			});

			listEl.innerHTML = cards.join("");
			statusEl.textContent = `${items.length} tutorial directories found.`;
		}

		function buildTopicFilters(items, suggestedCategoryTags) {
			const discoveredTopics = new Set();

			items.forEach((item) => {
				getNonTutorialTopics(item).forEach((topic) => discoveredTopics.add(topic));
			});

			suggestedCategoryTags.forEach((topic) => discoveredTopics.add(topic));

			const topicButtons = [
				{ key: "all", label: "All" },
				...Array.from(discoveredTopics)
					.sort()
					.map((topic) => ({
						key: topic,
						label: topic
					}))
			];

			topicFiltersEl.innerHTML = topicButtons
				.map((topic) => `<button type="button" class="workshop-topic-button" data-topic-key="${topic.key}">${topic.label}</button>`)
				.join("");
		}

		function filterByTopic(items, topicKey) {
			if (topicKey === "all") {
				return items;
			}

			return items.filter((item) => getNonTutorialTopics(item).includes(topicKey));
		}

		function setActiveTopicButton(topicKey) {
			const buttons = topicFiltersEl.querySelectorAll(".workshop-topic-button");

			buttons.forEach((button) => {
				button.classList.toggle("is-active", button.dataset.topicKey === topicKey);
			});
		}

		try {
			const payload = await fetchCatalogData();
			const suggestedCategoryTags = Array.isArray(payload.suggestedCategoryTags)
				? payload.suggestedCategoryTags
				: [];
			const tutorials = (Array.isArray(payload.tutorials) ? payload.tutorials : [])
				.map((item) => ({
					...item,
					topics: Array.isArray(item.topics)
						? item.topics.map((topic) => String(topic).toLowerCase())
						: []
				}))
				.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

			if (tutorials.length === 0) {
				statusEl.textContent = "No tutorial directories found. Run python3 scripts/fetch_workshops_data.py and rebuild the site.";
				listEl.innerHTML = "";
				topicFiltersEl.innerHTML = "";
				return;
			}

			buildTopicFilters(tutorials, suggestedCategoryTags);

			let selectedTopicKey = "all";

			const applyFilters = () => {
				const query = filterEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
				const topicFiltered = filterByTopic(tutorials, selectedTopicKey);

				const combined = query
					? topicFiltered.filter((item) => {
						const haystack = `${item.name} ${item.description || ""} ${item.path || ""}`.toLowerCase();
						return haystack.includes(query);
					})
					: topicFiltered;

				renderCards(combined);
				setActiveTopicButton(selectedTopicKey);
			};

			applyFilters();

			filterEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
				applyFilters();
			});

			topicFiltersEl.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
				const target = event.target;

				if (!(target instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) {
					return;
				}

				const nextTopicKey = target.dataset.topicKey;
				if (!nextTopicKey) {
					return;
				}

				selectedTopicKey = nextTopicKey;
				applyFilters();
			});
		} catch (error) {
			listEl.innerHTML = "";
			statusEl.textContent = "Unable to load tutorial catalog data. Please ask a contributor to run the build again.";

			console.error(error);
		}
	})();
</script>

<div style="margin-bottom: 1000px;"></div>
:::
